reason: I do a few homes a year and my architect already hands me renderings, and the clients walk the plans with me. If I add a line item the homeowner has to agree to pay for it, and most don't want one more fee.
objection: I get calls from outfits like this all the time. Fifteen hundred a home is another line on a cost-plus bill my client has to approve, and I can't tell it beats what the architect already gives us.
would_change_my_mind: A homeowner of mine asking for it and agreeing to pay the line, or the lunch demo of one of my plans showing something that clearly avoids a change order.
